notes: Summary: Stratus Harbor builds a conversational product analytics assistant for product managers and CS teams.
Primary ask: start on Hosted API for speed -> move to Dedicated for steady peak traffic and data isolation.
Performance targets: 95th pct latency < 150ms for single-turn chat; user-facing RT < 300ms end-to-end.
Throughput: need ~500-800 rps at peak (batching expected to smooth tails).
Cost goals: unit economics target ~ $0.25 - $0.40 inference cost per active user / month; needs clear per-token breakdown.
POC results: Hosted POC (2 weeks) — latency OK for 95th with small cache; raw token cost higher than target (~30% over).

Workshop notes: recommended batching window 20-40ms for product chat (saves 12-18% tokens), KV/prefix caching for KB queries (~25% token savings on hit), and trial of 8-bit and Q4x quant profiles on Dedicated to reduce cost without regressing NLU metrics.
Quant profiles discussed: int8 / dynamic quant ops; SE suggested testing Q4_K_M and trimmed kv-cache-friendly variant. Action: Redwood to run A/B evals vs hosted baseline.
Customer quote: 'If we can shave unit cost by 30% and keep quality, Dedicated looks appealing — but need deterministic pricing and a simple BOM.'
Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logging retention 12 months, optional EU residency for subset of PII logs. Legal flagged data residency clause for dedicated infra.
Pricing conversation: evaluating reserved capacity monthly commit vs pay-as-you-go burst. Finance prefers fixed commit for forecasting but needs break-even analysis for first 6 months.
Next POC ask: run 3-month Dedicated pilot with two quantization profiles, live KV cache, and per-route cost telemetry exposed in Console.
Action items assigned: Leila to define quant test matrix; Jordan to send BOM + draft contract; Omar to prepare onboarding checklist for CSM handoff.
